        if (visitor == null) return false; switch (getType()) {
          case Token.ASSIGN:
          case Token.ASSIGN_ADD:

          case Token.ASSIGN_URSH:
          case Token.BLOCK:
          case Token.BREAK:
          case Token.CALL:
          case Token.CATCH:
          case Token.CATCH_SCOPE:
          case Token.CONST:
          case Token.CONTINUE:
          case Token.DEC:
          case Token.DELPROP:
          case Token.DEL_REF:
          case Token.DO:
          case Token.ELSE:
          case Token.ENTERWITH:
          case Token.ERROR:         // Avoid cascaded error messages
          case Token.EXPORT:
          case Token.EXPR_RESULT:
          case Token.FINALLY:
          case Token.FUNCTION:
          case Token.FOR:
          case Token.GOTO:
          case Token.IF:
          case Token.IFEQ:
          case Token.IFNE:
          case Token.IMPORT:
          case Token.INC:
          case Token.JSR:
          case Token.LABEL:
          case Token.LEAVEWITH:

          case Token.LETEXPR:
          case Token.LOCAL_BLOCK:

          case Token.NEW:
          case Token.REF_CALL:

          case Token.WHILE:

        }
